{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta_Recipes|Pasta]]

This is a simple way to serve [[Cookbook:Fiddlehead|fiddleheads]]. If fiddleheads are unavailable or out of season, [[Cookbook:Asparagus|asparagus]] or [[Cookbook:Artichoke|artichoke hearts]] could be substituted with good results. It goes well with a simple [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]], crusty [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]], and a nice dry [[Cookbook:White Wine|white wine]].

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Fiddlehead|fiddleheads]], cleaned and trimmed
*2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*1 small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*1 large portobello [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushroom]] cap
*170 g (6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) oil-packed sun-dried [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
*½ box of [[Cookbook:Linguine|linguine]]
*1 tablespoon toasted [[Cookbook:Pine Nut|pine nuts]]
*2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] the mushrooms, onions, and sun-dried tomatoes into long strips and set aside.
#[[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] the ferns and garlic in the olive oil for about 5 to 10 minutes.
#Add the onions, and sauté until they start to wilt.
#Add the mushrooms and sun-dried tomatoes. Continue to sauté for another 5 minutes or so.
#Season with salt and pepper, toss in the pine nuts, add a splash of water, reduce heat and cover. Let sweat for about 10 minutes (or so).
#During this, begin to cook the linguine so that it is ready when the topping is ready.
#In a large bowl, add the veggies to the linguine, sprinkle on the cheese, and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] well.
#Serve immediately.

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms, onions, and sun-dried tomatoes into long strips and set aside.
Sauté the ferns and garlic in the olive oil for about 5 to 10 minutes.
Add the onions, and sauté until they start to wilt.
Add the mushrooms and sun-dried tomatoes. Continue to sauté for another 5 minutes or so.
Season with salt and pepper, toss in the pine nuts, add a splash of water, reduce heat and cover. Let sweat for about 10 minutes (or so).
During this, begin to cook the linguine so that it is ready when the topping is ready.
In a large bowl, add the veggies to the linguine, sprinkle on the cheese, and toss well.
